decisions.reason: The Magento template closely builds on the firm's existing web design and e-commerce expertise, so it can effectively assimilate early feedback and improve, making a drop unlikely.
Responsive website templates are core to the firm's web development capabilities, enabling it to recognize value from user reactions and refine the template.
Premium support extends the firm's established customer service activities, allowing it to learn from client interactions and adjust the offering.
Although given its own page, the software version management tool is less directly related to the firm's core web service knowledge, limiting its absorptive capacity to improve from early results.

The data processing contract tool requires legal and compliance knowledge distant from the firm's existing information service strengths, reducing its ability to assimilate feedback and enhance the product.
